name: Sale Return Receipt
html:
{% set totals = frappe.db.sql("SELECT CAST(return_ht AS CHAR) AS return_ht, CAST(return_tva AS CHAR) AS return_tva, CAST(return_ttc AS CHAR) AS return_ttc, CAST(debt_reduction AS CHAR) AS debt_reduction, CAST(refund_amount AS CHAR) AS refund_amount FROM `tabSale Return` WHERE name=%s AND business=%s", (doc.name, doc.business), as_dict=True)[0] %}{% set line_amounts = frappe.db.sql("SELECT name, CAST(return_ht AS CHAR) AS return_ht, CAST(return_tva AS CHAR) AS return_tva, CAST(return_ttc AS CHAR) AS return_ttc FROM `tabSale Return Item` WHERE parent=%s AND parenttype='Sale Return'", doc.name, as_dict=True) %}

Return Receipt

Business: {{ frappe.db.get_value('Business', doc.business, 'business_name') }}

Original Invoice: {{ frappe.db.get_value('Sale', doc.original_sale, 'invoice_number') or doc.original_sale }}

Customer: {{ frappe.db.get_value('Customer', doc.customer, 'customer_name') if doc.customer else 'Walk-in Customer' }}

Return Date: {{ doc.get_formatted('return_date') }}

{% for row in doc.items %}{% set line = line_amounts | selectattr('name', 'equalto', row.name) | first %}{% endfor %}
ProductQuantityUOMHTTVATTC
{{ row.product_name }}{{ row.quantity }}{{ row.uom }}{{ line.return_ht or '0.000' }}{{ line.return_tva or '0.000' }}{{ line.return_ttc or '0.000' }}
Return HT{{ totals.return_ht or '0.000' }} TND
Return TVA{{ totals.return_tva or '0.000' }} TND
Return TTC{{ totals.return_ttc or '0.000' }} TND
Debt Reduction{{ totals.debt_reduction or '0.000' }} TND
Refund Amount{{ totals.refund_amount or '0.000' }} TND
Refund Status{{ doc.refund_status.replace('_', ' ').title() }}

Reason: {{ doc.reason }}

{% if doc.notes %}

Notes: {{ doc.notes }}

{% endif %}
